:::{#def-entropy-given-value}
#### Entropy given one value

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
the **entropy of $Y$ given $X=x$**, for a value $x$ with $\P(X=x) > 0$, is
the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) given $X=x$
of $\surprisalf{Y \mid x}$, the [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal) of $Y$ given $x$:

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X=x} \eqdef \condE{\surprisalf{Y \mid x}}{X=x}.$$

:::
